title: 看小满微笑

image_gen_arguments.prompt: Edit only her head, neck, gaze and mouth in image 1. She pauses with the pod held still and turns toward the child off-screen to her LEFT and SLIGHTLY BELOW eye level. Keep a modest three-quarter-left view and a neutral-to-slightly-down chin; both eyes clearly look left and a little downward. Give a small warm closed-mouth smile. The turn is a little farther than the intermediate, not a profile or upward lamp gaze. Keep the complete transparent frame and her identity: round glasses, grey bun, three red hairpin beads. Preserve both hands, fingers, the pod with exactly TWO seated beans, blouse, shoulders, bangle, basin, legs, shoes and every stool corner/foot exactly as image 1. No loose pea, extra object or text.

semantic_acceptance: 完整注意力到左方略下小满位置，双眼方向一致；具体实景视线仍待 Opus 确认。
与 c04/f03 有可读区别，温和闭口微笑，不变惊讶／大笑。
荚内两豆及两手位置不变；返回可复用 f03 后回 c04，是否自然须接景实看。
